notes.title: v1.11 Quick update for language
notes.content:
[h1][b]v1.11 Quick update[/b][/h1]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
·For those who can't get the right language for their PC, now you can select the game's language by using the top-right list in the menu.(Now it only support English and Chinese)

notes.title: v1.1 Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]v1.1 Update[/b][/h1]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
·Fixed moving glitch when didn't stop moving before collecting book
·Fixed no mouse glitch when getting caught while collecting book
·Fixed insane footstep issue when moving slowly
·Fixed modeling issue when looking up

[h1]Changes[/h1]
·Changed small amount of Koumakan's looking
·Changed all the items' moving animation
